q: (that which has been ordained, namely the Day of Qiyaamah)!
v.s: The Inevitable Reality -
v.c: The Inevitable Hour!

v.s: What is the Inevitable Reality?
v.c: What is the Inevitable Hour?

q: What shall inform you about what is the Inevitable?
v.s: And what can make you know what is the Inevitable Reality?
v.c: And what will make you realize what the Inevitable Hour is?

q: The Thamud and the Aad rejected the Clamour
(they refused to believe in the coming of Qiyaamah).
v.s: Thamūd and ʿAad denied the Striking Calamity [i.e., the Resurrection].
v.c: ˹Both˺ Thamûd and ’Ȃd denied the Striking Disaster.

q: As for the Thamud, they were destroyed by a deafening sound
v.s: So as for Thamūd, they were destroyed by the overpowering [blast].
v.c: As for Thamûd, they were destroyed by an overwhelming blast.

q: As for the Aad, they were destroyed by a freezing, furious wind.
v.s: And as for ʿAad, they were destroyed by a screaming, violent wind
v.c: And as for ’Ȃd, they were destroyed by a furious, bitter wind

q: Allaah unleashed it upon them for seven consecutive nights and eight consecutive days.
lying flat on the ground as if they were hollow palm trunks.
v.s: Which He [i.e., God] imposed upon them for seven nights and eight days in succession, so you would see the people therein fallen as if they were hollow trunks of palm trees.
v.c: which Allah unleashed on them non-stop for seven nights and eight days, so that you would have seen its people lying dead like trunks of uprooted palm trees.

q: Do you see any of them surviving?
(Despite their immense strength, none of them survived.)
v.s: Then do you see of them any remains?
v.c: Do you see any of them left alive?

q: (such as the nations of Nooh ﵊, Shu'ayb ﵊ and others)
v.s: And there came Pharaoh and those before him and the overturned cities with sin.
v.c: Also, Pharaoh and those before him, and ˹the people of˺ the overturned cities ˹of Lot˺ indulged in sin,

q: They disobeyed the Rusul of their Rabb so He seized
v.s: And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with a seizure exceeding [in severity].
v.c: each disobeying their Lord’s messenger, so He seized them with a crushing grip.

v.s: Indeed, when the water overflowed, We carried you [i.e., your ancestors] in the sailing ship
v.c: Indeed, when the floodwater had overflowed, We carried you in the floating Ark ˹with Noah˺,

m: and would be conscious of it
q: ...to make the incident a message for you
v.s: That We might make it for you a reminder and [that] a conscious ear would be conscious of it.
v.c: so that We may make this a reminder to you, and that attentive ears may grasp it.

q: When the trumpet will be blown once
(to signal the arrival of the Day of Qiyaamah)...
v.s: Then when the Horn is blown with one blast
v.c: At last, when the Trumpet will be blown with one blast,

v.s: And the earth and the mountains are lifted and leveled with one blow [i.e., stroke] -
v.c: and the earth and mountains will be lifted up and crushed with one blow,

q: will take place which is to take place.
v.s: Then on that Day, the Occurrence [i.e., Resurrection] will occur,
v.c: on that Day the Inevitable Event will have come to pass.

q: The sky will be split and become absolutely weak
v.s: And the heaven will split [open], for that Day it is infirm.
v.c: The sky will then be so torn that it will be frail,

q: (because the sky will collapse at the centre, the angels living there will move to the sides).
That day eight angels shall carry the throne of your Rabb above them
(and bring it to the Plains of Reckoning).
v.s: And the angels are at its edges. And there will bear the Throne of your Lord above them, that Day, eight [of them].
v.c: with the angels on its sides. On that Day eight ˹mighty angels˺ will bear the Throne of your Lord above them.

q: On that day, you will all be presented
v.s: That Day, you will be exhibited [for judgement]; not hidden among you is anything concealed.
v.c: You will then be presented ˹before Him for judgment˺, and none of your secrets will stay hidden.

q: As for the one who receives his record
(indicating that he is bound for Jannah),
v.s: So as for he who is given his record in his right hand, he will say, "Here, read my record!
v.c: As for those given their records in their right hand, they will cry ˹happily˺, “Here ˹everyone˺! Read my record!

q: “I was always convinced that I shall certainly meet my reckoning.”
v.s: Indeed, I was certain that I would be meeting my account."
v.c: I surely knew I would face my reckoning.”

q: So he will enjoy a pleasing life...
v.s: So he will be in a pleasant life -
v.c: They will be in a life of bliss,

v.s: In an elevated garden,
v.c: in an elevated Garden,

q: (At any time, a person will be able to have any one of the fruits that he desires for, without any effort.)
v.s: Its [fruit] to be picked hanging near.
v.c: whose fruit will hang within reach.

q: (The people will be told in Jannah,)
“Eat and drink with all blessings as a reward for the
deeds that you sent ahead during the days gone by
v.s: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you put forth in the days past."
v.c: ˹They will be told,˺ “Eat and drink joyfully for what you did in the days gone by.”

q: As for the one who receives his record
(indicating that he is bound for Jahannam),
he will cry, “Oh dear! If only I were not given my record...”
v.s: But as for he who is given his record in his left hand, he will say, "Oh, I wish I had not been given my record
v.c: And as for those given their record in their left hand, they will cry ˹bitterly˺, “I wish I had not been given my record,

q: “...and I had not known my reckoning!”
v.s: And had not known what is my account.
v.c: nor known anything of my reckoning!

q: “Alas! If only death had been my end
(so that I would not have to witness this day)!”
v.s: I wish it [i.e., my death] had been the decisive one.
v.c: I wish death was the end!

v.s: My wealth has not availed me.
v.c: My wealth has not benefited me!

q: (the authority I had in this world for which I broke Allaah's commands)
v.s: Gone from me is my authority."
v.c: My authority has been stripped from me.”

q: (Addressing the angels of punishment, Allaah will say,)
and place a yoke around his neck!”
v.s: [God will say], "Seize him and shackle him.
v.c: ˹It will be said,˺ “Seize and shackle them,

v.s: Then into Hellfire drive him.
v.c: then burn them in Hell,

q: “Then fasten him in a chain seventy cubits in length.”
(This refers to a chain that is very large.)
v.s: Then into a chain whose length is seventy cubits insert him."
v.c: then tie them up with chains seventy arms long.

q: “Verily he did not believe in the Majestic Allaah...”
v.s: Indeed, he did not used to believe in God, the Most Great,
v.c: For they never had faith in Allah, the Greatest,

q: (let alone spending in charity and feeding the poor,)
v.s: Nor did he encourage the feeding of the poor.
v.c: nor encouraged the feeding of the poor.

q: “There shall neither be any friend for him today
v.s: So there is not for him here this Day any devoted friend
v.c: So this Day they will have no close friend here,

q: (the puss and blood oozing from the wounds of the people of Jahannam).”
v.s: Nor any food except from the discharge of wounds;
v.c: nor any food except ˹oozing˺ pus,

q: Only the Sinners shall eat it
v.s: None will eat it except the sinners.
v.c: which none will eat except the evildoers.”

q: I swear by the things that you see...
v.s: So I swear by what you see
v.c: Now, I do swear by whatever you see,

q: ...and by the things that you do not see!
v.s: And what you do not see
v.c: and whatever you cannot see!

q: Verily this Qur'aan is a word brought
v.s: [That] indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is the word of a noble Messenger.
v.c: Indeed, this ˹Quran˺ is the recitation of a noble Messenger.

q: It is not the speech of a poet.
v.s: And it is not the word of a poet; little do you believe.
v.c: It is not the prose of a poet ˹as you claim˺, ˹yet˺ you hardly have any faith.

q: Neither is it the speech of a fortune-teller.
v.s: Nor the word of a soothsayer; little do you remember.
v.c: Nor is it the mumbling of a fortune-teller, ˹yet˺ you are hardly mindful.

q: It is a revelation from the Rabb of the universe.
v.s: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.
v.c: ˹It is˺ a revelation from the Lord of all worlds.

q: (ascribed to Allaah words that Allaah had not revealed)...
v.s: And if he [i.e., Muhammad] had made up about Us some [false] sayings,
v.c: Had the Messenger made up something in Our Name,
v.h: The Quran Is Not a Fabrication

q: (shall not allow him to go unpunished and We)
v.s: We would have seized him by the right hand;
v.c: We would have certainly seized him by his right hand,

v.s: Then We would have cut from him the aorta.
v.c: then severed his aorta,

q: ...and none of you will be able to protect
(However, since nothing like this happened, it proves that Rasulullaah ﷺ propagated truly the message of Allaah.)
v.s: And there is no one of you who could prevent [Us] from him.
v.c: and none of you could have shielded him ˹from Us˺!

q: is certainly advice for those with Taqwa.
v.s: And indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a reminder for the righteous.
v.c: Indeed, this ˹Quran˺ is a reminder to those mindful ˹of Allah˺.
v.h: The Quran Is the Absolute Truth

v.s: And indeed, We know that among you are deniers.
v.c: And We certainly know that some of you will persist in denial,

q: shall certainly be a source of remorse
(because they will regret not accepting it when they suffer punishment for their rejection).
v.s: And indeed, it will be [a cause of] regret upon the disbelievers.
v.c: and it will surely be a source of regret for the disbelievers.

v.s: And indeed, it is the truth of certainty.
v.c: And indeed, this ˹Quran˺ is the absolute truth.

q: So glorify the name of your Majestic Rabb.
v.s: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.
v.c: So glorify the Name of your Lord, the Greatest.
